time.sleep(0.5)
# focus the terminal window
pyautogui.click(530, 380)
time.sleep(0.3)
# show each report's contents with separators for inspection
pyautogui.typewrite('for f in ~/patch-audit/reports/*.txt
do echo "===== $f ====="
sed -n \'1,200p\' "$f"
echo
done\n', interval=0.01)
time.sleep(0.5)
traj.r: Reflection: The terminal is open and focused; we listed ~/patch-audit/reports and saw six report files. A grep for "late" returned no matches, so the next step is to read each report to find install dates and determine which are late.

time.sleep(0.5)
# focus the terminal window (approx center)
pyautogui.click(531, 391)
time.sleep(0.3)
# search report files for lines containing 'install' or 'installed' (case-insensitive) to show install dates

time.sleep(0.5)
traj.r: Reflection: The README is confirmed and the terminal is focused. To determine which reports are late I need the install dates from each report; I'll search the reports for lines mentioning the install or installed date so we can identify late devices.
